sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B — AI Model | MindStudio
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is Alibaba's latest flagship Mixture-of-Experts model, with 35B total parameters and only 3B activated per token (256 experts, 8 routed + 1 shared). Built on direct feedback from the community, Qwen3.6 prioritizes stability and real-world utility, offering developers a more intuitive, responsive, and genuinely productive coding experience.
